source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Four contests in Fermanagh")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'There will be no contests in the other Irvinestown areas'; the nominations print 'Castlecaldwell, Anthony Ruddy ...' (page image read 7 Nov 2026)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Irvinestown rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Garrison was the only contested division; the Fermanagh Herald prints the other nominations, showing one change of member. Printed 'Anthony Ruddy'; the 1952 list prints 'Anthony Roddy, senr.' for the same division. Returned unopposed.
